title: Equal-height cards
summary: Flex items stretch to the tallest sibling; margin-top: auto pins the price to the bottom.
explanation: align-items defaults to stretch, so every card in the row is as tall as the tallest one. You do not need to set any height.
Each card is itself a flex column. margin-top: auto on the price takes all the spare height above it, so prices line up along the bottom edge whatever the text length.
tryThis: Set align-items: flex-start on .row: the cards shrink to their content and the prices no longer line up.
Remove margin-top: auto from .price and see it follow the text.
